name: lo-fi hip hop
prompt: Warm 1990s-style lo-fi hip hop, dusty boom bap drums, mellow Rhodes piano, jazzy guitar, upright bass, vinyl crackle, tape hiss, relaxed swing, intimate late-night atmosphere
prompt_zh: 溫暖的 1990 年代 lo-fi hip hop，灰塵感 boom bap 鼓組、柔和 Rhodes 電鋼琴、爵士吉他、直立貝斯、黑膠雜訊、卡帶嘶聲、鬆弛搖擺、深夜氛圍
negative: modern EDM, trap, aggressive drums, bright pop production, vocals
negative_zh: 現代 EDM、trap、侵略性鼓組、明亮流行製作、人聲

name: boom bap hip hop
prompt: Classic 1990s underground boom bap hip hop, dusty kick and snare, chopped jazz samples, warm upright bass, vinyl texture, swung humanized groove
prompt_zh: 經典 1990 年代地下 boom bap hip hop，灰塵感大鼓與小鼓、切碎爵士取樣、溫暖直立貝斯、黑膠質感、人性化搖擺律動
negative: trap, modern EDM, autotune, polished digital production, vocals
negative_zh: trap、現代 EDM、autotune、過度 polished 的數位製作、人聲

name: city pop
prompt: 1980s Japanese city pop, glossy electric bass, chorused guitar, Rhodes electric piano, punchy gated drums, warm analog synths, nostalgic summer night
prompt_zh: 1980 年代日本 city pop，明亮電貝斯、chorus 吉他、Rhodes 電鋼琴、飽滿 gated 鼓、溫暖類比合成器、懷舊夏夜
negative: metal, harsh distortion, lo-fi noise, modern EDM
negative_zh: 金屬、強烈失真、lo-fi 噪音、現代 EDM

name: synthwave
prompt: 1980s synthwave, warm analog polysynths, gated reverb drums, arpeggiated bass, neon night-drive atmosphere, retro-futuristic
prompt_zh: 1980 年代 synthwave，溫暖類比 polysynth、gated reverb 鼓、arpeggio 貝斯、霓虹夜駕氛圍、復古未來感
negative: acoustic folk, orchestral, modern pop, vocals
negative_zh: acoustic folk、管弦樂、現代流行、人聲

name: ambient
prompt: Slow ambient soundscape, warm evolving pads, soft drones, gentle field recordings, spacious reverb, calm and weightless
prompt_zh: 緩慢 ambient 音景，溫暖演化 pad、柔和 drone、環境錄音、寬廣殘響、平靜漂浮
negative: drums, aggressive percussion, EDM drop, vocals
negative_zh: 鼓組、侵略性打擊、EDM drop、人聲

name: cinematic
prompt: Cinematic instrumental score, evolving strings, warm brass, soft piano, subtle percussion, emotional wide dynamics
prompt_zh: 電影配樂式器樂，演化弦樂、溫暖銅管、柔和鋼琴、細膩打擊、情緒化寬廣動態

name: jazz
prompt: Warm acoustic jazz, swinging ride cymbal, upright bass walking line, expressive jazz piano, brushes, intimate club room
prompt_zh: 溫暖 acoustic jazz，swing ride、直立貝斯 walking、表現力爵士鋼琴、鼓刷、親密俱樂部空間

name: funk
prompt: 1970s funk groove, syncopated slap bass, tight wah guitar, punchy brass stabs, crisp drums, analog warmth
prompt_zh: 1970 年代 funk groove，切分 slap bass、緊實 wah 吉他、銅管短句、清脆鼓組、類比溫暖

name: house
prompt: Warm deep house, four-on-the-floor kick, shuffling hi-hats, round sub bass, soulful chords, analog texture
prompt_zh: 溫暖 deep house，四拍大鼓、shuffle hi-hat、圓潤 sub bass、靈魂和弦、類比質感

name: rock
prompt: Indie rock instrumental, overdriven guitars, driving bass, live acoustic drums, warm room ambience
prompt_zh: 獨立搖滾器樂，過載吉他、驅動貝斯、現場鼓組、溫暖房間殘響

name: folk acoustic
prompt: Warm acoustic folk instrumental, fingerpicked guitar, mandolin, soft upright bass, intimate room sound, natural dynamics
prompt_zh: 溫暖 acoustic folk 器樂，指彈吉他、曼陀林、柔和直立貝斯、親密房間聲、自然動態
negative: EDM, distorted guitar, aggressive drums, vocals
negative_zh: EDM、失真吉他、侵略性鼓組、人聲

name: pop
prompt: Bright modern pop instrumental, clean production, catchy chord progression, punchy drums, warm bass
prompt_zh: 明亮現代流行器樂，乾淨製作、朗朗上口和弦進行、飽滿鼓組、溫暖貝斯
negative: harsh noise, metal, lo-fi clutter, vocals
negative_zh: 刺耳噪音、金屬、lo-fi 雜亂、人聲
